description: This file defines an internal class KeyExtensionTestGrain implementing the IKeyExtensionTestGrain interface within the Orleans framework. It includes methods to retrieve a grain reference and an activation ID.

classes.name: KeyExtensionTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class used for testing key extensions, providing methods to get its reference and unique activation ID.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Returns a task that resolves to a reference of this grain cast as IKeyExtensionTestGrain.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Returns a task that resolves to the unique string representation of the grain's GUID activation ID.
